Success criteria: Stand the sauce jar on the table close to the left of the round pot, with their bodies side by side and approximately aligned front to back. The jar bottom must rest on the table, no longer suspended, and both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Near the round pot, leave clearance for the can and gripper to avoid the pot rim and protruding handle. If adjusting the pose, do so in a more open area to reduce sweeping contact.
- Lower the can slowly before releasing and confirm its base is supported by the table, avoiding a tip-over from releasing while suspended.
